title: Checkout latency spike after deploy
description: checkout-api p99 latency rises ~5x minutes after a deploy that migrated datasource settings to a new config loader. The client-side DB connection pool silently shrank; the database itself is healthy.

past_incidents.title: Checkout 503s from exhausted Hikari connection pool
past_incidents.root_cause: CHECKOUT_DB_POOL_MAX env var dropped during Helm refactor; pool fell back to library default of 10
past_incidents.resolution: Rolled back checkout-api; restored explicit pool size in chart values

past_incidents.title: Payments latency from acquirer degradation
past_incidents.resolution: Waited for provider recovery; added latency alert on provider

distractors: payments-gateway latency blip at 08:50 that recovered by 09:03
a single slow payments call logged at 09:39

ground_truth.summary: Deploy v2.14.7 lost the explicit pool size during the config-loader migration; HikariCP defaulted to 10 connections and requests queue for connections.

abstain_variant.rationale: Without change history, pool logs or pool metrics only the symptom (latency) and distractors remain.

fault_variants.name: logs_http_500
fault_variants.rationale: Error groups, metrics and change history still establish the cause.
